description: A painted interior scene: a woman with hair in a bun and a dark high-collared, puffed-sleeve dress sits at a wooden desk writing with a pen. A lit hanging oil lamp glows above. Stacks of printed sheets and newspapers, an inkwell, and a pen sit on the desk. Behind her are an old iron printing press and shelves of books, with a type case at right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge. No legible text.
